senses.gloss: decision, esp. decision by lot or sign, divination, augury; means or tools of divination.—Pl. as ab. Lam. R. introd. (R. Josh. 2) התחיל קוסם ק׳ he began to make divinations (by throwing arrows &c.); Koh. R. to XII, 7 לקסום ק׳.
